title: HONEST LOSS: C won in 11 steps, E lost with an Anti-Pattern in the prompt
shows: C goes to the dresser, then countertop, drawers, diningtable and finds the mug in 11 steps. E opens and closes drawer 1, walks around, goes to the dresser (the target) repeatedly and never finds the mug on the diningtable. Rules shown: the recipe and the "do not repeat examine" Anti-Pattern.
why_interesting: E is not strictly better than C. The recipe "search the area first, open any closed containers" is consistent with what E did, but the extra rules did not prevent a search loop. A fair example of paired losses (E lost where C won 4 of 70 games in this library).
notes: The planner collapsed the task into 3 subgoals including "go to dresser 1" before finding the mug.
